Overview

Campinas is a city in SP with a population of 1,213,792. A major tech and research hub in São Paulo state, home to Unicamp university and a thriving life sciences and technology sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
